history.name: Jumper
history.summary: Speeds up Face Collections with a new storage format, adds a Summary Analysis timeline and watch-folder analysis, and improves visual analysis performance. Upgraded collections require current Jumper on every computer sharing them. Windows build 1637 is dated November 19.

history.name: Jumper
history.summary: Adds current-timeline search and dragging matched ranges into Resolve and other NLEs, transcript exports and people-management controls. Fixes incorrect frame analysis in some Avid Op-Atom MXF media.
